column1: # Generated by `lake exe oracle paths` (spec/Oracle.lean) from the definition
# in spec/Aontu: documents with paths, each case its declarations and a map
# as the schema against a map as the document, run in the default mode,
# without the fill (noFill) and under --partial (partial), as `verdict` rows
# whose expectation is the one class `vet` gives the document with its paths
# read as names, which `vetP_iff` makes the definition's own. A path resolves
# in the schema's own tree, through maps and lists and through nothing else,
# and reads as the term at its position in the schema met with the data; a
# path to nothing is an error, as is a document that reads only by its own
# paths. Regenerate with `make spec`; never edit by hand. The cases the ports
# do not yet answer this way are listed in spec/ledger.tsv.
# Paths through the riders follow in rows q0 on, which a path reads through,
# and key(n) reached through a path or a name, read where it lands, in rows r0 on.
# Relative paths, made absolute where each stands, follow in rows j0 on, and
# maybe, absence where all that is wrong with a path is that it names nothing,
# in rows mb0 on, and pref, each literal a preference and each preference a
# rank weaker, in rows pf0 on. Paths into a call's output, which resolve in the
# root with its calls made, follow in rows pc0 on, and move, a preference of
# the value a path reads with its source hidden, in rows mv0 on. Paths into
# what a call over a path makes, which resolve a round later, follow in rows
# rn0 on, and refer, a link that keeps its address, its template met into
# its target, in rows rf0 on. rel, a relation whose value holds a link at
# each leaf, follows in rows rl0 on, and links read where they land, in a
# spread's template or copied by a path reference, in rows ld0 on, and in a
# generator's template, at each member of its output, in rows lg0 on.
